## Sequence Diagram(s)
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  participant Extrinsic as Disputes Extrinsic
  participant Disputes as Disputes.transition
  participant STF as ChainSTF.transition
  participant Header as Block Header
  participant Reports as Reports.transition

  Extrinsic->>Disputes: execute()
  Disputes-->>STF: Result{ offendersMark: HashSet<Ed25519Key>, stateUpdate }
  STF->>Header: read offendersMarker
  Header-->>STF: headerOffendersMark (iterable)
  STF->>STF: checkOffendersMatch(offendersMark, headerOffendersMark)
  alt mismatch
    STF-->>Extrinsic: Err(StfErrorKind.Offenders)
  else match
    STF->>Reports: transition(input + offenders: HashSet)
    alt reporter ∩ offenders ≠ ∅
      Reports-->>STF: Err(ReportsError.BannedValidator)
    else ok
      Reports-->>STF: Ok(...)
      STF-->>Extrinsic: Ok(final state)
    end
  end
```

  participant Host as Write.execute

  Host->>Accounts: write(storageKey, storageKeyLength, maybeValue)
  alt Ok
    Accounts-->>Host: Ok
  else Full
    Accounts-->>Host: Err("full")
  end
```

sequenceDiagram

  participant Loader as State JSON Loader
  participant Compat as Compatibility(GP version)

  Loader->>Compat: isGreaterOrEqual(V0_6_7)?
  alt >= 0.6.7
    Loader->>Parser: JsonServiceInfo.fromJson(new fields present)
  else older
    Loader->>Parser: JsonServiceInfoPre067.fromJson(legacy shape)

  /**
   * Create SortedSet from array that is not sorted. This function sorts the array.
   * Duplicates are detected and are not allowed.
   */
  static fromArrayNoDuplicates<V>(comparator: Comparator<V>, array: readonly V[]) {
    const data = array.slice();
    data.sort((a, b) => comparator(a, b).value);
    const dataLength = data.length;

    for (let i = 1; i < dataLength; i++) {
      if (comparator(data[i - 1], data[i]).isEqual()) {
        throw new Error(
          `Expected array without duplicates: duplicate detected at sorted indices ${i - 1} and ${i}`
        );
      }
    }

    return new SortedSet(data, comparator);
  }
```

</details>

<!-- suggestion_end -->
